R3.F_gap: production artifacts, publication, physical device and independent review
R3.F_next: exact-head CI readback then governed build/device validation
R3.F_ok: scoped code and host falsifiers passed

authority: User requested hotfix of these two repositories; local producer governs implementation; Drive governs private continuity receipt.

cross_repository_execution.path: actual producer source sealer -> actual live sealer -> actual app importer

falsifier: failed update/show/download/metadata, missing/script/wrong-ABI Ninja, inconsistent declarations, not-installed dpkg or absent/wrong graph output must fail

preflight.data: PUBLIC source metadata and synthetic fixtures only
preflight.federated_route: Drive current-state dispatch -> local Termux producer/consumer indices
preflight.governance: reversible source candidate; no merge/release/provider mutation
preflight.security: signed APT/key pin/prefix/ABI fail-closed preserved; first failing APT stage must stop

rollback: abandon unmerged candidate; reviewed compensating revert if merged; preserve predecessor and history

tests.execution: stdlib runner with isolated tmp_path per existing test function
